Name: Nullcap (Neutral Mushroom)
Description: A small, grayish-white mushroom with a translucent cap that glows faintly in total darkness. Found in clusters along damp cave walls and abandoned mines.
Effects:
• Neutral — no known magical or alchemical properties.
• Creatures sometimes use them as markers in dark environments due to their faint bioluminescence.
Lore: Some say the Nullcap is the "ghost" of once-powerful fungi, drained of purpose but still clinging to the Underdark.

Name: Widow’s Bell (Harmful Mushroom)
Description: A dark purple, bell-shaped mushroom that releases faint melodic chimes when disturbed. The sound is eerie and hypnotic.
Effects:
• Inhalation of spores causes a mild hallucinogenic effect followed by paralysis within 1 minute (DC 14 CON save or paralyzed for 1d4 hours).
• Handling it unprotected exposes one to the spores.
Lore: Believed to grow where widows have wept or where mournful songs have echoed in the deep. Drow sometimes use it in poisons.

Name: Embergill Bloom (Beneficial Mushroom)
Description: A golden-orange mushroom with frilled gills that radiate soft warmth. Found in geothermal caves near lava vents or hot springs.
Effects:
• When brewed into a tea or eaten raw, it grants 1d4 temporary hit points and advantage on saving throws against disease for 24 hours.
• Has mild healing properties when turned into a salve.
Lore: Revered by deep gnomes (Svirfneblin) as a gift from the earth's heart. Often used in healing rituals or given as offerings to earth spirits.
